title: Second Minimum Node In a Binary Tree
summary: Given a non-empty special binary tree where each node has a non-negative value, and each node's value is the minimum of its two children, determine the second smallest value among all the nodes in the tree.
statement: Given a non-empty special binary tree where each node has a non-negative value, and each node's value is the minimum of its two children, determine the second smallest value among all the nodes in the tree. If no such second smallest value exists, return -1.
constraints: The special tree has each internal value equal to the smaller of its two child values.
Return the smallest distinct value greater than root.val, or -1 if no such value exists.
